title: Photography
text:
As a wizard and scholar of Middle-earth, I have been studying the magic of the natural world for centuries. Through my self-portraits, I aim to capture the essence of my own being and reflect on my own journey through time. Each photograph is a reflection of my own experiences and emotions. Through my photography, I hope to offer a glimpse into my life as a scholar and adventurer, and inspire others to reflect on their own journeys through the world.

Introduction
My name is Simon Lynn. I am a first-year Biostatistics Master of Science student at Case Western Reserve University. My program specializes in genomic analysis and bioinformatics while providing a comprehensive foundation across the broader field of biostatistics. I earned my Bachelor of Science in Data Analytics with a specialization in Biomedical Analytics from the Ohio State University. I have a strong background in overall data analytics as well as biomedical data science through my academic pursuits.
My professional goal is to leverage advanced analytical methods to advance our understanding of disease and mitigate its impact on public health.
Please feel free to contact me by email or at my personal phone number (216) 339-4583 for any questions or opportunities.
